headword: {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}

definitions.explanation: A triangle in which all three sides are of equal length and, equivalently, all three interior angles are equal at 60°. The most symmetric of the triangle types and a foundational figure in elementary and middle-school geometry.

examples.japanese: {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}を{描|か}く。
{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}の{内角|ないかく}はすべて{60度|ろくじゅうど}だ。
examples.english: All interior angles of an equilateral triangle are 60 degrees.

examples.japanese: コンパスと{定規|じょうぎ}があれば{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}は{簡単|かんたん}に{作図|さくず}できる。
examples.english: With a compass and a ruler, you can easily construct an equilateral triangle.

examples.japanese: {一辺|いっぺん}の{長|なが}さが{分|わ}かれば、{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}の{面積|めんせき}や{高|たか}さは{公式|こうしき}を{使|つか}って{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: If you know the length of one side, you can find the area and height of an equilateral triangle using a formula.

notes:
Composed of {正|せい} (regular; correct, used as a geometric prefix meaning 'regular' as in {正方形|せいほうけい} 'square'), {三角|さんかく} (triangle), and {形|けい} (shape). The {正|せい} prefix indicates that all sides and angles are equal, paralleling 'regular polygon' in English.

USAGE:
A core term in elementary and middle-school mathematics. The reading {せいさんかくけい} is the standard textbook reading, but {せいさんかっけい} (with sokuon) is also widely heard and is often listed as an alternative reading. Often appears alongside {直角三角形|ちょっかくさんかくけい} (right triangle) and {二等辺三角形|にとうへんさんかくけい} (isosceles triangle) when classifying triangles. The {正|せい}〜{形|けい} pattern extends to {正方形|せいほうけい} (regular square) and {正多角形|せいたかくけい} (regular polygon).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}を{描|か}く: to draw an equilateral triangle
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}を{作図|さくず}する: to construct an equilateral triangle (in geometry)
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}の{面積|めんせき}: area of an equilateral triangle
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}の{一辺|いっぺん}: one side of an equilateral triangle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三角形|さんかくけい}: triangle — the general term
- {二等辺三角形|にとうへんさんかくけい}: isosceles triangle — two sides equal, the next-most-symmetric type
- {直角三角形|ちょっかくさんかくけい}: right triangle — has one 90° angle
- {正方形|せいほうけい}: square (regular quadrilateral) — built from the same {正|せい}〜{形|けい} pattern
- {正多角形|せいたかくけい}: regular polygon — the broader category to which {正三角形|せいさんかくけい} belongs
